clientTransportOwnerReadback.rationale: A client transport refusal does not establish whether a prior effect occurred. Preserve the original task and request identifiers and inspect the owner before further input.
clientTransportOwnerReadback.evidenceRequirement: Exact original task identifier; original request identifier where an effect was attempted. Caller must supply existing authenticated transport configuration.

remediation.instruction: Repair the existing authenticated transport or its base URL using the supplied client interface. Re-read the same retained task. Do not broaden authorization or replay input.
remediation.precondition: Caller has independently reviewed the same owner endpoint and authentication configuration. No uncertain effect is authorized for replay.

clientTransportOwnerReadback.resumeCondition: Exact retained task identity and current control are verified; inspect the original operation with getTaskOperation before deciding whether any input may continue. Unresolved or uncertain originals remain blocked from replay.

clientArgumentCorrection.rationale: Only the enumerated pre-dispatch caller-input/configuration checks normalize to this code. An owner, transport, stale-handle or permission failure is not an invalid argument.
clientArgumentCorrection.evidenceRequirement: Original TypeError message and recovery.source/recovery.owningFunction. No argument values or credential material belong in logs. Local errors have no invented owner occurrence ID.

inspect.precondition: Read the already returned local error and match its exact source and owningFunction against the qualified contract. This is not a file-read command or an installed-source availability claim.

remediation.instruction: Read the owning function advertised argument signature and original TypeError message. Correct only the named missing, invalid or contradictory field using the same owner-approved policy and original intended scope. A pure request-builder call may validate corrected request arguments without dispatch. For HTTP helper configuration, correct the existing endpoint/fetch configuration without changing the intended operation. Preserve original task/request IDs.
remediation.precondition: The exact source check is admitted by the normalization contract and this validation dispatched no owner request. Prior workflow outcomes remain subject to their own original readback.

verification.precondition: Read the already returned local error and match its exact source and owningFunction against the qualified contract. This is not a file-read command or an installed-source availability claim.

clientArgumentCorrection.resumeCondition: The original local input contract passes, the existing authenticated owner is observed, and any preceding uncertain operation has been reconciled before resuming the same intended call. A status read alone does not validate caller arguments or grant authority.

serviceClientTransportReadback.rationale: An observability transport failure does not establish an owner operation outcome. The public owner status read is available without inventing a task scope.
serviceClientTransportReadback.evidenceRequirement: Existing authenticated Service endpoint and original operation identity where applicable.

remediation.instruction: Repair the existing authenticated Service transport configuration and re-read status. Preserve original IDs and inspect any original mutation receipt before replay.
remediation.precondition: Caller has reviewed the original endpoint and access configuration; no permission expansion or automatic mutation retry is authorized.

serviceClientTransportReadback.resumeCondition: The same owner endpoint is readable and original operation uncertainty is reconciled. Status alone is not proof that a mutation did not occur.

serviceTabHandleReadback.rationale: Read the same retained browser/tab record. For a known stale handle, refreshServiceTabHandle with repairPolicy reject_only and the exact existing handle; do not open a replacement browser or replay the interrupted command. Missing handles require original context readback before renewal.
serviceTabHandleReadback.evidenceRequirement: Original TypeError/Error source and owningFunction, exact original context and typed owner failure when present. Unknown outcomes remain unknown.

inspect.precondition: Supply the original authenticated endpoint and original browser identity; do not adopt another browser.

remediation.instruction: Read the same retained browser/tab record. For a known stale handle, refreshServiceTabHandle with repairPolicy reject_only and the exact existing handle; do not open a replacement browser or replay the interrupted command. Missing handles require original context readback before renewal.
remediation.precondition: Existing original handle and authenticated scope must be supplied. Refresh may validate or reject; it must not be changed to open_if_missing or replace_duplicates by this recipe.

verification.precondition: Supply the original authenticated endpoint and original browser identity; do not adopt another browser.

serviceTabHandleReadback.resumeCondition: The returned handle passes requireServiceTabHandle and original operation uncertainty is reconciled before any further command.

serviceDurableHandoffReadback.rationale: Inspect current route readiness for the original browser and re-open the same retained durable handoff URL. Missing URL/readiness is not permission to create another handoff or publish a provider URL.
serviceDurableHandoffReadback.evidenceRequirement: Original TypeError/Error source and owningFunction, exact original context and typed owner failure when present. Unknown outcomes remain unknown.

inspect.precondition: Supply the original authenticated endpoint and existing browser identity. Never create a new handoff merely to reconnect.

remediation.instruction: Inspect current route readiness for the original browser and re-open the same retained durable handoff URL. Missing URL/readiness is not permission to create another handoff or publish a provider URL.
remediation.precondition: Original browser/handoff identity and existing authentication are retained; inspect requires no new handoff effect. Native Remote View owner repairs remain under existing authority.

verification.precondition: Supply the original authenticated endpoint and existing browser identity. Never create a new handoff merely to reconnect.

serviceDurableHandoffReadback.resumeCondition: The same durable handoff resolves and operatorVisible.state is ready; original browser identity is unchanged.

serviceAccessPlanReadback.rationale: Re-read the current access plan with the same profile/target/account scope. Follow the current advertised CDP or CDP-free recipe. Repair missing/contradictory owner route evidence through current owner reads rather than editing the observed plan or loosening policy.
serviceAccessPlanReadback.evidenceRequirement: Original TypeError/Error source and owningFunction, exact original context and typed owner failure when present. Unknown outcomes remain unknown.

inspect.precondition: Supply the existing authenticated endpoint and exact original profile/target identity. Missing identity is not guessed; retain original query/account scope.

remediation.instruction: Re-read the current access plan with the same profile/target/account scope. Follow the current advertised CDP or CDP-free recipe. Repair missing/contradictory owner route evidence through current owner reads rather than editing the observed plan or loosening policy.
remediation.precondition: Preserve original profile, target, account and permission scope; do not substitute whichever profile the broker happened to select.

verification.precondition: Supply the existing authenticated endpoint and exact original profile/target identity. Missing identity is not guessed; retain original query/account scope.

serviceAccessPlanReadback.resumeCondition: A fresh plan supplies a complete compatible recipe for the exact intended identity and the local owner-readiness check passes.

serviceAccessPlanSeedingReadback.rationale: Re-read the original access plan. If current policy still requires manual seeding, use the existing scoped manual-seeding acquisition and native handoff under its existing authority; then run the advertised bounded post-seeding verification. Do not execute a command string from an error or toggle allowManualAction just to bypass the refusal.
serviceAccessPlanSeedingReadback.evidenceRequirement: Original TypeError/Error source and owningFunction, exact original context and typed owner failure when present. Unknown outcomes remain unknown.

inspect.precondition: Supply the existing authenticated endpoint and exact original profile/target identity. Missing identity is not guessed; retain original query/account scope.

remediation.instruction: Re-read the original access plan. If current policy still requires manual seeding, use the existing scoped manual-seeding acquisition and native handoff under its existing authority; then run the advertised bounded post-seeding verification. Do not execute a command string from an error or toggle allowManualAction just to bypass the refusal.
remediation.precondition: The current plan still requires seeding; exact original profile, authorized operator and current supported acquisition arguments are independently available. No private credential or provider access is inferred.

verification.precondition: Supply the existing authenticated endpoint and exact original profile/target identity. Missing identity is not guessed; retain original query/account scope.

serviceAccessPlanSeedingReadback.resumeCondition: Fresh owner plan/readiness evidence verifies the intended profile and target; the original interrupted operation remains unreplayed until reconciled.

serviceMonitorFreshnessReadback.rationale: Read current original target/profile monitor results. Use the existing advertised monitor/probe workflow to refresh only that evidence, then re-read the access plan. Do not set allowMonitorFreshnessRisk or overwrite verification metadata to bypass missing or expired evidence.
serviceMonitorFreshnessReadback.evidenceRequirement: Original TypeError/Error source and owningFunction, exact original context and typed owner failure when present. Unknown outcomes remain unknown.

inspect.precondition: Use existing authenticated endpoint and retain original target/profile filters when inspecting the relevant monitor.

remediation.instruction: Read current original target/profile monitor results. Use the existing advertised monitor/probe workflow to refresh only that evidence, then re-read the access plan. Do not set allowMonitorFreshnessRisk or overwrite verification metadata to bypass missing or expired evidence.
remediation.precondition: Existing target/profile context and current owner-approved verification procedure are retained. No unknown or denied evidence becomes fresh merely through a read.

verification.precondition: Use existing authenticated endpoint and retain original target/profile filters when inspecting the relevant monitor.

serviceMonitorFreshnessReadback.resumeCondition: Fresh owner evidence verifies the exact target/profile and the monitor safety check passes; failure or uncertainty remains visible.

serviceCdpFreeOwnerReadback.rationale: A missing CDP-free capability response is an owner readback gap, not authorization to attach CDP or relaunch.
serviceCdpFreeOwnerReadback.evidenceRequirement: Original retained launch job/receipt and exact browser identity when available.

inspect.precondition: Supply the exact original Service job ID and original authenticated endpoint. Do not fabricate a job/task identifier or repeat launch to obtain one.

remediation.instruction: Inspect the original launch job and retained browser mode. Restore the missing owner result through supported readback. Keep lifecycle-only restrictions; do not enable CDP attachment or launch another browser to reconstruct evidence.
remediation.precondition: Original launch job and existing authenticated owner are known; unresolved launch outcomes remain non-replayable.

verification.precondition: Supply the exact original Service job ID and original authenticated endpoint. Do not fabricate a job/task identifier or repeat launch to obtain one.

serviceCdpFreeOwnerReadback.resumeCondition: The exact original owner result supplies capability evidence and summarizeServiceCdpFreeLaunchAvailability succeeds; requested action remains supported in the original mode.
